The '''Deadon system''' was a part of the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of the [[Deadon Ice Temples]].<ref name="HR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deadon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-6.<ref name="TEA" />
